data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 16.6m (2014: favourable development of GBP 10.9m); this comprises releases of GBP 16.0m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business, releases of GBP 0.3m in respect of direct Aviation business, GBP 0.2m in respect of total Reinsurance business and Other direct business releases of GBP 0.1m.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net favourable prior year development of GBP 16.6m in 2015, which was described as a release. This favourable development was primarily driven by releases in direct Third Party Liability business (GBP 16.0m), direct Aviation business (GBP 0.3m), total Reinsurance business (GBP 0.2m), and Other direct business (GBP 0.1m). The report notes that the combined ratio reflects prior year releases across a number of Casualty classes.
raw_causal_phrases: prior year releases across a number of Casualty classes
releases of GBP 16.0m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business
releases of GBP 0.3m in respect of direct Aviation business
releases of GBP 0.2m in respect of total Reinsurance business
Other direct business releases of GBP 0.1m
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is only explicitly stated as a net figure of GBP 16.6m. Gross prior year development and gross LOB movements could not be extracted as they were not provided in the report.
